records.text: According to financial documents in the public domain, Jamie Spears Sr. was giving 10% of his conservatorship income to Calvary Chapel Brentwood where Lou Taylor's husband was a pastor, giving tens of thousands of dollars in one year alone to a church 500 miles from where he lives in Louisiana
records.speaker: Brett Cooper

appearances.snippet: Mr. Spears at times gave 10% of his conservatorship income to the Taylors' Calvary Chapel Brentwood—a practice known as tithing—according to a 2010 financial document. Mr. Spears gave tens of thousands of dollars in one year alone to the church, which is about 500 miles away from where he lives in Louisiana.

verification.notes: A New York Times investigation based on a 2010 financial document reported that Jamie Spears at times gave 10 percent of his conservatorship income to Calvary Chapel Brentwood. The Roys Report, summarizing the same investigation, states that the church received tens of thousands of dollars from him in one year. The episode accurately quotes those details.
